heroTitle: From Engineering to Art, Design & Brand Leadership
heroBlurb: A passionate guy, always chasing experiences that let creativity take the lead.
intro:
A passionate guy, always chasing experiences that let creativity take the lead — that search for creative expression is really where my story begins. Not in marketing, but with a paintbrush.

Growing up, I was constantly experimenting with different forms of art, until I found my way to digital — and that's when I had to learn the Adobe suite and the tools that come with it. That hands-on curiosity became my gateway into the world of digital design, and from there, into branding.

Academically, I trained as an engineer — a background that gave me a structured, problem-solving way of thinking. But art kept pulling at me, and eventually those two sides came together: the discipline of engineering and the creativity of design, shaping how I approach marketing and brand strategy today.

That path has taken me across different industries and projects, both in Bahrain and beyond, working on everything from brand identities to full marketing campaigns. Most recently, I was part of the pre-opening team at Sheraton Bahrain Hotel — part of Marriott International, the world's largest hotel chain — a role built on trust, and one that reflects everything this journey has led to.
